Container.Name: Dragonwilds
Container.Overview: RuneScape: Dragonwilds dedicated server (official Steam AppID 4019830, installed via SteamCMD). Auto-updates on start, hourly save backups, graceful shutdown and crash restart. Set OWNER_ID (your in-game Player ID from Settings) and ADMIN_PASSWORD, forward the UDP port on your router, then search for your exact world name under Worlds > Public in-game. RAM: 2 GB + 1 GB per player (8 GB for 6). First start downloads ~10 GB.

Config.Name: Game Port (UDP)
Config.Description: Must match the PORT variable below. Forward this UDP port on your router to your Unraid IP.

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Game files, saves, config and backups. Put the appdata share on cache/SSD for best performance.

Config.Name: Owner ID
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Your RuneScape: Dragonwilds Player ID (bottom of the in-game Settings menu, use the copy button).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Anyone who enters this in the in-game Server Management screen becomes an admin.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Display name of the server.

Config.Name: Default World Name
Config.Description: Name of the world created on first start. Players find the server by searching this EXACT name (case sensitive) under Worlds > Public.

Config.Name: World Password
Config.Description: Optional join password. Leave blank for an open server.

Config.Name: Server Port
Config.Description: UDP port the server listens on. Must equal the host port mapped above.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Official maximum is 6.

Config.Name: Update On Start
Config.Description: Run SteamCMD on every container start. Restart the container after a game patch to update.

Config.Name: Validate On Start
Config.Description: Verify all game files with SteamCMD on start (slow, use to repair a broken install).

Config.Name: Auto Restart
Config.Description: Restart the server process automatically if it crashes.

Config.Name: Backup Interval (min)
Config.Description: Minutes between save backups. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Backups To Keep
Config.Description: How many backup archives to retain in /data/backups.

Config.Name: Backup On Stop
Config.Description: Take a backup when the container stops.

Config.Name: Stop Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a clean save on shutdown before force-killing. Keep below the --stop-timeout in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Extra Launch Args
Config.Description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the server binary.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: e.g. America/New_York — used for log and backup timestamps.
